## Symptom
`verify` fails on a content check right after a deploy and passes minutes later with nothing redeployed (run:fixture-org/menuboard/7861204418, run:fixture-org/menuboard/7861391150).

## Root cause
The freshly deployed Worker is cold for longer than expected. The 30 s timeout and two retries were not enough for it to warm up, so the content check failed again (run:fixture-org/menuboard/7861204418). The re-run minutes later passed because the Worker was warm by then (run:fixture-org/menuboard/7861391150).

## Fix / workaround
Raise the verify request timeout to 120 s and retry five times (issue:fixture-org/menuboard#41).

## How it is caught
It is not. The failure disappears on a re-run (raw:20261021T141130Z-a41f08b6).
